description:
Goal
Restore the native selective-receive continuation contract for fixtures2/behavior/receive_selective_refs.fz.

Baseline proof
At integration parent f8a7557a0, tests/fz2_cli.rs::run_and_interp_execute_receive_fixtures and tests/fz2_cli.rs::build_executes_receive_fixtures both panic at src/compiler2/native_codegen/terminator.rs:182: continuation callee 32 has 1 logical argument but 2 published parameter representations. The fz-1ah.12 candidate reproduces the same invariant failure at its corresponding line with telemetry absent, proving .12 did not introduce it.

Strategy
Reopen the data-model seam behind closed fz-go4.10 rather than weakening the invariant. Prove which authority owns the selective-receive outcome closure and its logical delivery arguments, then make continuation parameter representations consume that authority once.

Acceptance
Both exact CLI tests pass for run, interp, and build. The logical-argument/published-representation invariant remains enforced. No telemetry compensation or fixture exception is introduced.
title: Restore selective-receive continuation delivery contract
